effects: Sets the signer's single governance delegate to _to and replaces any earlier delegate. The old delegate loses vote power equal to the signer's current WSGB balance.
Gives _to governance vote power equal to the signer's current WSGB balance (ownerToken 0x02f0…B9ED). Later balance changes follow the delegation.
When _to is the zero address, the call is an undelegation and the vote power goes back to the signer.
No tokens or native value move, and no approval is set. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: Intent 'Delegate all vote power to {_to}', with the delegate address shown as 'To'.

findings.title: delegate: _to = zero address reads 'Delegate all vote power to 0x000…0', but it actually undelegates.
findings.evidence: GovernanceVotePower.sol delegate(): `if (_to != address(0)) { addVP(...) }`, and undelegate() calls delegate(address(0)). Case 2 screen: 'Delegate all vote power to 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'.
findings.fix: In the To field, show a label or message for the zero address that says 'none (undelegate)'.

findings.title: delegate: the amount is the signer's WSGB balance from storage, and the old delegate is not shown.
findings.evidence: delegate(): `uint256 senderBalance = ownerToken.balanceOf(msg.sender); address currentTo = getDelegateOfAtNow(msg.sender); if (currentTo != address(0)) subVP(...)`. Neither value is in the calldata.
findings.fix: Optionally say 'governance vote power of your WSGB' in the intent. Neither the balance nor the previous delegate can be shown.

findings.title: delegate: 'vote power' does not say governance, so it is ambiguous next to WSGB FTSO delegation.
findings.evidence: userdoc: 'Delegate all governance vote power of `msg.sender` to `_to`.' Descriptor intent: 'delegate all vote power'.
findings.fix: Use 'Delegate all governance vote power to {_to}'.

effects: Removes the signer's governance delegate, and the delegate loses vote power equal to the signer's current WSGB balance.
The vote power goes back to the signer. No tokens or native value move.
formats.shown: Intent 'undelegate vote power', with no fields.

findings.title: undelegate: the delegate being removed comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: undelegate() calls delegate(address(0)). currentTo = getDelegateOfAtNow(msg.sender) is read from storage, and the function has no parameters.
findings.fix: None possible. Optionally reword to 'Undelegate governance vote power'.
